
# DEME Housepainting

> Family-run interior and exterior house painting business, run by a father-son team and based in Ireland.

DEME Housepainting provides interior and exterior house painting services, from single-room jobs to full exterior repaints.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.demehousepainting.ie/): Overview of the business and quote enquiries.
- [About Us](https://www.demehousepainting.ie/#about): Information about the people behind the business.
- [Gallery](https://www.demehousepainting.ie/#gallery): Before-and-after photos of completed painting work.
- [Contact](https://www.demehousepainting.ie/#contact): Contact form for quotes and enquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.demehousepainting.ie/privacy.html): Privacy information for website visitors and contact-form enquiries.
